title: Uncertainty-based Continual Learning with Adaptive Regularization
sections_checked: Supplement: seed counts, hyperparameter grids and initial-uncertainty sensitivity
evidence_note: Reports competitive supervised and eight-task continual-RL performance; CNN vision results average eight seeds. Supplement shows β and initial uncertainty jointly trade off forgetting, capacity and exploration; low initial uncertainty can impair later-task learning. Multi-headed task protocols and baseline availability vary.

title: Comparative Evaluation of Big-Data Systems on Scientific Image Analytics Workloads
sections_checked: §§3–4 two scientific image pipelines and five system implementations
evidence_note: On two 2016-era scientific image pipelines, engine ranking varies by operation, dataset size and tuning; Dask is at most 14% faster end-to-end in one setting, 60% slower for one subject, and Myria achieves near-linear scaling. Only two workloads/AWS setup; optimized engine version and tuning affect transfer.

title: An Empirical Analysis of the Influence of Fault Space on Search-Based Automated Program Repair
evidence_note: On GenProg and four Defects4J projects, fault-space accuracy correlates with fixes and search cost; augmented tests help selected cases (e.g. Math 5 validations 306→28) but leave some cases unchanged and worsen localization for Math 53. Java/GenProg scope; developer changed lines used as fault-location oracle.

title: Invariant Feature Mappings for Generalizing Affordance Understanding Using Regularized Metric Learning
sections_checked: §4 dataset, class imbalance and evaluation splits
Table 1 classification metrics and baseline comparison
evidence_note: On 265 RGB-D images and 23 affordances, LMCA-R mean F1 0.70 vs kNN 0.63/CNN-SVM 0.69 over 25 random 70/30 splits. Accuracy can mislead under imbalance (spraying ~96% accuracy but F1 0.56); hanging/loop grasping are noisy. No manipulation-in-novel-clutter evaluation; labels are vague and capture environment is constrained.
